div.span: Rules in every graph: loops have a limit (OCR once, repair twice) · parallel steps write to separate parts of the state and the next step waits for all of them · the AI judges, the code checks every quote and does all the maths · emails and phone numbers are removed from CV text before it goes to the AI.
